title: Layouts of root level parallel routes do not render properly

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/jfangrad/parallel-routes-issue/

### To Reproduce

1. Start the application in development
2. Notice the UI shows only 
![Screenshot 2023-11-15 at 2 09 35 PM](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/11445215/5363c930-b0e9-47d9-a7ce-fe32f8d14959)

3. Change the value of `isRoute1` in `src/app/layout.tsx` to `false` and save
4. Notice the UI now shows 
![Screenshot 2023-11-15 at 2 10 29 PM](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/11445215/d9c77414-57da-4324-ac8d-13d8e53b12ad)


### Current vs. Expected behavior

Following the steps above, at **step 2** I expected to see output of
```
Test route 1 layout
Page 1 content
```

But instead only saw output of
```
Page 1 content
```

For some reason the layout for `route1` parallel route is being ignored but the layout for `route2` is not.

A bandaid solution that allowed both layouts to render properly was to put a `(default)` (or any group name) route group as the direct child of each parallel route and then place all files inside that route group. For some reason this change allows the layout for both parallel routes to work.

**Note:** Ran with both `14.0.2` and `^14.0.3-canary.9` but saw the same output.

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
  Platform: darwin
  Arch: arm64
  Version: Darwin Kernel Version 23.1.0: Mon Oct  9 21:27:24 PDT 2023; root:xnu-10002.41.9~6/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000

Relevant Packages:

Next.js Config:
  output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

App Router

### Additional context

I tried recreating in a sandbox but the I could not reproduce in that enviroment.

However I was able to produce this bug in more than one next project (one on v13 and and clean slate v14)
